jobs.title: Commisson Officer Level 3
jobs.description:
Commissioned Security Officer – Level III NEEDED!!!!

Command Security Inc is seeking a reliable, professional, and highly experienced Commissioned Security Officer – Level III to provide security at a client facility in Dallas, TX.

This position requires a strong security presence, excellent situational awareness, and the ability to interact professionally with staff, visitors, and members of the public. The ideal candidate is dependable, alert, and capable of handling security concerns while maintaining a safe and professional environment.

Position: Armed Security Officer – Commissioned Level III

Location: Dallas, TX

Schedule

  • Monday to Friday 7:30am-4pm

Pay

$$21.00-22.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

Position Overview

The Armed Security Officer will maintain a highly visible security presence at the assigned facility and help protect personnel, visitors, property, and assets.

The officer will monitor the facility, control access points, respond to incidents, conduct security checks, communicate with management and emergency personnel when necessary, and complete detailed security documentation.

Job Duties

  • Maintain a highly visible armed security presence throughout the assigned facility.
  • Monitor entrances, exits, and designated access points.
  • Control and monitor access to the facility in accordance with post orders.
  • Conduct routine security checks and patrols of assigned areas.
  • Monitor CCTV and other security systems as assigned.
  • Respond promptly to radio/walkie-talkie communications.
  • Identify and respond appropriately to suspicious activity, safety concerns, and security incidents.
  • Utilize professional conflict resolution and de-escalation techniques.
  • Respond to emergencies in accordance with company policies and post orders.
  • Contact law enforcement, fire department, EMS, or other emergency services when appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate Daily Activity Reports (DARs) and incident reports.
  • Communicate professionally with client management, employees, visitors, and emergency personnel.
  • Maintain assigned firearm and equipment in accordance with company policies and applicable Texas laws and regulations.
  • Maintain a professional and courteous demeanor at all times.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support the security operation.

Requirements

  • Valid Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer – Level III License REQUIRED.
  • Must be currently authorized to perform armed security work in Texas.
  • Must maintain all required Texas DPS licenses, registrations, and qualifications in good standing.
  • Minimum 8 years of security experience preferred.
  • Previous armed security, law enforcement, military, corporate security, or high-visibility security experience preferred.
  • Excellent observation and situational-awareness skills.
  • Strong communication and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Strong conflict-resolution and de-escalation skills.
  • Must be comfortable using radios, CCTV, access-control systems, and other security technology.
  • Must be able to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Must follow all company policies, client requirements, and post orders.
  • Must maintain a professional appearance and report to work in complete uniform.
  • Reliable transportation to the Dallas, TX location.
  • Must be dependable, punctual, and professional.

IMPORTANT

This is an armed security position at a professional client facility. The officer will be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment while providing a professional and courteous presence.

Applicants must possess a valid Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer (Level III) License and meet all applicable requirements to perform armed security services in Texas.

Only qualified applicants who meet the Texas DPS requirements for commissioned armed security officers will be considered. Please call 713-291-7829 for more information, ask for Demon.

Pay: $21.00 - $22.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

  • Do you have your proper credentials listed on the ad?
  • Are you available to work the schedule posted?
  • When are you available to start?

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Description

Now Hiring: Level 3 Armed Security Officers for Overnights & Weekends

Join a Trusted Name in Texas Security – 20+ Years Strong

Verified Response Security & Investigations (VRSI) is growing, and we’re seeking dedicated, professional Level 3 Commissioned Officers to join our team in both full-time and part-time roles.

If you\'re passionate about community safety and professionalism, we want to hear from you.

️ About Us

For over two decades, VRSI has been a respected name in Texas security. Our officers don’t just work posts—they make an impact. We take pride in providing highly trained, reliable professionals to serve and protect our communities with integrity.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Multiple shifts available: evenings, overnights, weekends
  • Positions are primarily in multi-family residential communities
  • Flexibility is key—we appreciate and reward reliability

Responsibilities

Officers will be responsible for:

  • Enforcing community rules and curfew policies
  • Responding to service calls and reporting maintenance issues
  • Supporting local law enforcement and emergency services during incidents
  • Maintaining a strong and visible security presence

Requirements

To be considered, applicants must have:

  • A valid Level 3 Pocket Card
  • At least 1 year of verifiable experience
  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Personal vehicle (public transportation not accepted)
  • Working smartphone
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening
  • Required duty gear, including:
  1. Firearm (.38 cal or higher)
  2. Level 3 holster
  3. Two extra magazines
  4. OC spray (with current certification)
  5. Handcuffs and flashlight

Perks include:

  • Paid holidays (1.5x pay rate)
  • Paid vacation after 12 months
  • Complimentary ASSIST membership with benefits:
    • $10,000 AD&D policy
    • Free Telehealth access
    • Discounted US Law Shield coverage
  • Flexible schedules and referral bonuses

Apply Today

Ready to serve with one of Texas’s most trusted security companies?
We look forward to meeting you.

At Verified Response Security & Investigations, we proudly serve the Dallas-Fort Worth community with comprehensive, professional security solutions tailored to diverse needs. As a full-service firm, we offer:

- Alarm Response

What sets us apart is our unmatched ability to match the right officer to the right assignment. From multi-family communities and commercial properties to individual clients requiring personal protection, we approach every assignment with precision, purpose, and professionalism.

Our growing reputation as a leader in the Texas security industry is rooted in two things: our dedication to client satisfaction and our commitment to employee retention. At VRSI, we don’t just provide security—we build trust through consistency, integrity, and unwavering responsiveness.

jobs.title: Elite Security Operator- Level 3 and 4 only
jobs.description:
Overview
At Wolves Protection Group, we do not hire “guards” — we recruit operators. Our team is built on discipline, precision, and the relentless pursuit of excellence. Every member carries the responsibility of protecting lives, property, and our reputation with unwavering professionalism. We are seeking dedicated and vigilant Elite Security Operator to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for our clients, employees, and visitors. This role requires a proactive approach to security, including monitoring premises, preventing loss, managing conflicts effectively, utilizing proper documentation. The Elite Security Operator will utilize various security measures and technologies to ensure safety and compliance with regulations.

Why Join the Wolves:
- Elite-level training and professional growth opportunities
- A culture of loyalty, discipline, and mutual respect
- Assignments that challenge your skills and reward your commitment
- Advancement opportunities for proven leaders and high performers

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and patrol assigned areas to deter and detect signs of intrusion or suspicious activity.
  • Operate surveillance equipment, limited to a certified body cam.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, incidents, or emergencies, providing first aid or CPR when necessary.
  • Enforce rules and regulations while maintaining a professional demeanor in all interactions.
  • Conduct regular inspections of buildings and grounds to identify potential security risks or hazards.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement agencies as needed during incidents or investigations.
  • Document daily activities, incidents, and observations in detailed reports for management review.
  • Assist in loss prevention efforts by identifying theft or fraud attempts and taking appropriate action.
  • Manage conflicts effectively using conflict management techniques to resolve issues peacefully.
  • Maintain a commanding presence and demonstrate exceptional situational awareness
  • Uphold our code of conduct with discipline, integrity, and loyalty
  • Execute security operations with precision, professionalism, and discretion
  • Protect clients, assets, and property with no room for error
  • Adhere to all operational protocols, including required gear, licensing, and body camera usage

Requirements

  • Previous experience in security, law enforcement, military service, or related fields is preferred.
  • Knowledge of first aid and CPR certification is highly desirable.
  • Strong observational skills with the ability to remain alert and attentive at all times.
  • Excellent communication skills for interacting with diverse groups of people.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations calmly and professionally while maintaining confidentiality.
  • Must be able to pass background and drug checks as required by company policies. Join us in ensuring safety and security within our community while developing your skills in a rewarding environment!

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule
  • Referral program

Application Question(s):

  • Our job sites are located in Dallas, Irving, Plano, Mesquite, and more. Are you willing and able to work at any location assigned by the Wolves?
  • Are you willing and able to travel up to 45 minutes or more to an assigned work location when needed?
  • Do you have reliable transportation to and from your assigned work locations?
  • Do you have open availability to work the schedules assigned by the Wolves?
  • Do you prefer full-time or part-time employment?
  • Do you currently hold a TX Level III Security License? If so, is your license active and in good standing?
  • This current position starts at $20/hr, does this meet your desired pay rate?
  • When would you be available to start if hired?
  • Are you willing to complete a drug screening and background check as part of our hiring process?

Work Location: In person
